scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (48s at [02:30] and 50s at [04:45]) without announcing hold or thanking customer upon return.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe into the customer's setup, asking zero diagnostic questions regarding router indicator lights, test socket, microfilter, or connected devices.

grader.scenario: Broadband speeds 12Mbps against 70Mbps stay-fast guarantee; quiet line test reveals HR fault; agent fails Dead Air and Probing
grader.notes: The agent booked an Openreach engineer to repair a high-resistance copper fault causing broadband speed drops. However, the agent failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds without announcing holds or thanking the caller upon return, and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions about router lights, wiring, microfilters, or internal devices.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [02:30] Agent left an unmanaged silence of 48 seconds while running line test, and another unmanaged silence of 50 seconds at [04:45] while booking engineer, with no hold announcements or thanks.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:34] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, your broadband throughput has collapsed to approximately twelve megabits per second over the last three days...' - Accurate and complete paraphrase.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [03:42] Agent: 'Obviously high resistance faults occur when copper wire joints suffer rainwater corrosion or oxidation...' - Professional and objective technical explanation.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked zero probing questions regarding internal wiring, router lights, test sockets, or wireless vs ethernet connections before dispatching an engineer.
